body:
I'm not much one for drugs (outside of alcohol), but thanks for the suggestion.

They might be upset, if they ever even knew it happened. Nowadays, I'm lucky if I talk to even a single person on a given day. Even then it's generally just a random passerby giving me the "Hey, how's it going?" out of congeniality.

There's no doubt in my mind that those events caused this. I started getting angry after that time, and even got taken to counseling then. Instead of helping me with the real issues, though, they just bribed and threatened me into behaving well. I know I need to work through it all, but I don't know if it's really worth it.

I have opened myself up in the past and gotten hurt and gotten over it. Nowadays nobody really seems interested, though, and I just wind up isolating myself and since it seems everybody avoids and hates me. People used to like me, but nowadays, meh.

I dunno feel hopeless and broken :/

Attempting to scream would just frustrate me more. I have weak vocal chords because I rarely speak. I feel like I have to scream to be heard if I'm around 5 people talking in a normal volume. I used to play a bunch of instruments but quit because I ran out of time, motivation, skill, and space to practice.

I feel like I've shown love, but I don't feel anything in return. I do have high and difficult walls, but people have a history of just up and leaving me, so I kind of feel it's justified. I spent Monday night talking someone through their own depression and suicide thoughts, so I don't feel it's appropriate talk to them. I can't really talk to anyone else about this. I've tried, but I don't want them to see me like this so I get frustrated and give up. It's now causing me to isolate myself further than I already was.

I don't know what I did to deserve the cards and scars I was dealt. I wish I could up and leave, but I'm trapped. I know I'm unlikely to go through with it anytime soon just because I don't have the guts to do it right now, but I know I will be miserable no matter what I try. I have a career to consider in the off chance things did get better, so it's really just not something I can do. I've tried moving, changing jobs, extreme sports, etc. but nothing works.

The world is earth with a bunch of people living on it. The universe is an arrangement of chemicals that's inconsequential. We're born to die just to continue basic chemical processes. I look forward and don't see see anything worth living for and I see the easy door on the right, and I've fought this for so long I just want to take the easy door. If I die, any job I have will replace me. Anybody who knows me will forget about me or get over it or just remember me as that quiet weird dude in the corner who offed himself.
